content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a fixed 5-stage closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new, repeat, or failing tasks), 2) Retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory systems, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (autonomously create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (record results and update the knowledge base to improve future performance), with the core goal of minimizing user manual planning intervention for routine tasks.
